title: Introducing Binance VIP Convert Recurring Rebate Program
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We are excited to launch the  Binance VIP Convert Recurring Rebate Program ! This program is an exclusive offering designed specifically for Binance VIP users subscribed to  Convert Recurring , a feature that enables users to automate their crypto investments by setting up recurring conversions at regular intervals. The program offers tiered rebates based on the user’s monthly recurring investment amount and the length of their investment tenure, as detailed in the table below. How to Participate All users who fulfill the following criteria will be able to participate in this program: Verified  Binance  VIP 1-9 users   are eligible to join the program;    Indicate your interest and opt in via this  link  to activate your rewards; To earn rebates, ensure that each of your  Convert Recurring plan(s)  meet  both criteria by the end of each calendar month : Minimum Tenure: 30 days per plan Minimum Monthly Recurring Investment: $10,000 per plan Please Note: Binance VIP users who have existing Convert Recurring plans can still qualify for the program once they  opt in via this link .  Plans that run over 60 days will earn multiplier rebates for even greater rewards, as per the table below. Plans that  did not meet the minimum 30-day Tenure  but have  accumulated at least $10,000 Monthly Recurring Investment by the end of each calendar month  can still be eligible for rebate in the  following month  once the tenure requirement is met. However, the accumulated Monthly Recurring Investment will  not  be carried over to the following month to meet the minimum requirement. Please refer to the Case Examples section below for more information. Binance VIP Convert Recurring Rebate Program Tier Monthly Recurring Investment (USD) Tenure Rebate Rate as Per Basis Point (BPS) Gold $10,000 to $50,000 At least 30 days 3 BPS of recurring amount Gold+ At least 60 days 1.2x of 3 BPS of recurring amount (3.6 BPS) Platinum More than $50,000 At least 30 days 4 BPS of recurring amount Platinum+ At least 60 days 1.5x of 4 BPS of recurring amount (6.0 BPS) How to Receive Rewards: The rebate amount will be credited on a monthly basis to each user’s spot account in USDC tokens,  within 3 weeks  after the last day of each calendar month. Rebate calculations are calculated at the individual plan level, based on the accumulated plan value (USD equivalent) per plan in each calendar month. The tenure of each plan ends on the last day of the calendar month. The length of each tenure per month is calculated as the following: Tenure = First day of next calendar month - Start date of each plan Case Examples: A user has 2 or more existing plans (A, B) and 1 new plan (C) set up on 2025-08-21. Plan Tenure as of 2025-08-31 Recurring Investment (USD) Rebate Tier  Rebate Rate as Per Basis Point (BPS) Rebate Amount (USDC) A 35 10,000 Gold 3 BPS 3 B 65 50,000 Platinum+ 6 BPS 30 C 10 10,000 None 0bps 0 Total Rebate for user in August  33 The user  continues  all plans, and the  tenure of each plan increases . Plan C becomes eligible for rewards on  both August and September investments . Plan Tenure as of 2025-09-31 Recurring Investment (USD) Rebate Tier  Rebate Rate as Per Basis Point (BPS) Rebate Amount (USDC) A 65 10,000 Gold+ 3.6 BPS 3.6 B 95 50,000 Platinum+ 6 BPS 30 C 40 10,000 (September) Gold 3 BPS 3 C 40 10,000 (August) Gold 3 BPS 3 Total Rebate for user in September 39.6 Notes: Plans cannot be combined to meet the minimum requirements, only standalone plans that meet the full criteria of each month will qualify. Plans must remain active for the full period of calendar month to be eligible for rebate in the same month. Cancelled plans are not eligible. *Existing Recurring Plans that are ongoing/active with minimal tenure of 30 days as of 2025-08-06 will also qualify if they meet the above criteria after opt-in. Enroll to the Program Now! Guides & Related Materials: All You Need to Know About Binance Convert How to Use Binance Convert Frequently Asked Questions on Binance Convert “Recurring” A Beginner’s Guide to Candlestick Charts  How to Read the Most Popular Crypto Candlestick Patterns Terms and Condition: Only  verified  Binance  VIP 1-9 users  are eligible to join the program.    VIP Convert Recurring Rebate Program will run from 2025-08-06  to 2025-10-31 . Users may receive multiple rebates if they have multiple qualifying plans, each plan will be evaluated separately. Only Convert Recurring convert trades shall count . The following types of trades will not count as successful trades: One-time Purchase Recurring is not counted; API trades on Binance Convert; Trade from stablecoin to stablecoin; Convert trades on old tokens that have previously undergone a token swap, redenomination or merging event, to the corresponding new token. Rewards will be distributed within  three weeks  after each calendar month. Users will be able to see rebates in USDC token in Spot Account. Binance reserves the right to disqualify any participants who tamper with Binance program code, or interfere with the operation of Binance program code with other software. Binance reserves the right to disqualify trades that are deemed to be wash trades or illegally bulk-registered accounts, as well as trades that display attributes of self-dealing or market manipulation. Binance reserves the right at any time in its sole and absolute discretion to determine and/or amend or vary these terms without prior notice, including but not limited to canceling, extending, terminating or suspending these Promotions, its eligibility terms and criteria, the selection and number of winners, and the timing of any act to be done; and all participants of this Promotion shall be bound by these amendments.  For clarity, Binance’s decisions with respect to all aspects of this Promotion are also final and non-appealable. For more information, see the  Convert Term of Use . Additional terms and conditions that also apply to this Promotion are accessible  here . Where there is any uncertainty around the terms and conditions, Binance shall apply its own discretion.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support!
